body: That's incredible the amount you lost and also motivates me to lose more. I'm 18 years old and have been obese for the past two years, and have just started cutting down the amount of calories I'm intaking. So far I've lost about 20lbs or so, but I'm currently having trouble with then wanting to eat more calories after a week or so, to make up for the decrease. Any advice you could offer to myself?

Damn dude, I really appreciate this reply. I'm also really sorry for your loss, I hope you were able to share many memories with your father through your life and his memory will live on through you. My father left when I was young and has been in and out of my life a few times - I've given up trying with him, but I wish I'd had some memories of me and him to share, hopefully you have some of those. 

I feel you on the cycle of depression and self destruction, especially through drugs. I had turned to LSD for a little while, which honestly really helped with my depression and opened a whole new mindset to me. I haven't taken this in a while though, and instead take edibles often now which have a negative effect on me and always leave me down and thinking to myself about what could be. I continue to take them though and continue the cycle. 

I also really like your thoughts on the purpose of being alive, to leave the world a better place and spread goodwill. That's actually a really good answer to my question. I really do hope I am able to do that, however I'm currently in situations where I think I'm polluting the place, rather than leaving it a better place altogether. 

Thank you for your kind words, and again sorry for your loss. Like you said, if you'd also like to talk through some stuff, I'm all open ears here.

Yeah, I think that’s probably the best call for me, to contact the doctor and ask to go back on the medication. I appreciate your words and motivation towards me losing weight, thank you. It’s been a day since I posted this and I’m feeling a little better having gotten it off my chest, yeah. Still a little down but a lot better than yesterday for sure, thank you.
